mapper.update: DELETE FROM idempotency_record WHERE operation=#{p.operation} AND idempotency_key=#{p.key} AND expires_at<=#{p.now}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_record(tenant_id,id,operation,idempotency_key,request_digest,status,expires_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (current_setting('app.tenant_id')::uuid,#{p.id},#{p.operation},#{p.key},#{p.digest},'IN_PROGRESS',#{p.expiresAt},#{p.now},#{p.now}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,operation,idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT request_digest,result_reference,status FROM idempotency_record WHERE operation=#{p.operation} AND idempotency_key=#{p.key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_record SET status='SUCCEEDED',result_reference=#{p.result},updated_at=#{p.now} WHERE operation=#{p.operation} AND idempotency_key=#{p.key} AND status='IN_PROGRESS'
DELETE FROM idempotency_record WHERE operation=#{p.operation} AND result_reference=#{p.result}
